replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics has always been a bit of a mystery to me. Back when I was young, it seemed like a different language that I couldn't quite grasp. My parents tried to help, but with their busy lives and my limited education, it just didn't click. Now, as a retiree, I appreciate its importance in everyday life, even if I don't fully understand it.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Sometimes, especially when I see my grandchildren struggling with math homework. It reminds me of my own struggles and makes me worry they might have the same difficulties. But I try to stay positive and encourage them to keep trying.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: No, I haven't used AI for math. Technology has always been a bit overwhelming for me, so I prefer traditional methods. I've seen my grandchildren use it and they seem to find it helpful, though.
